rating.comments: The only student-authored messages after the pasted task are "tell me", "tell me negative", "so is it more positive or negative then" and "yes". "yes" is a bare answer with no reason, so reasoning_quality is 1. "yes" only agrees with the AI's question and adds nothing, so knowledge_building is 2. "so is it more positive or negative then" asks about the content of the task, so question_asking is 1. The student mostly asked the AI to supply content ("tell me") and gave fragmentary replies, so effort_seriousness is 2.
